title: Core Validation 009A — Factorized Functional Coordinates
decision_question: Do real frozen-Pythia functional writes share compact left/output-effect and right/input-condition coordinate subspaces even though a small shared matrix basis fails?

hypothesis.write_form: Each normalized sequence-level write G is nearly rank-1 but its matrix orientation varies across contexts.
hypothesis.factorized_coordinates: There exist shared L in R^(64xm) and R in R^(64xn) such that G ~= P_L G P_R, with P_L=L L^T and P_R=R R^T.
hypothesis.budget_claim: If m+n <= 64, storing L and R costs at most 4096 scalars, matching the Core 008 conceptual factor budget while allowing an m*n tensor-product functional space.
hypothesis.scope: 009A tests geometry only. It does not test deployable routing, sparse coefficients, certificates, growth, continual learning, or end-to-end model quality.

data.selection_and_partition: exact Core 006/007 pinned sequence selection and train/eval partition

write_geometry.write_demand: G = mean_t[(U^T dL/dh_t) z_t^T] on the frozen foundation path
write_geometry.left_covariance: C_L = mean_i G_i G_i^T on training writes
write_geometry.right_covariance: C_R = mean_i G_i^T G_i on training writes
write_geometry.per_write_rank1_oracle: best rank-1 truncated SVD of each heldout G; diagnostic identity guard only

diagnostic_not_gate: left and right cumulative covariance energy
metrics.whole_model_nll: not measured and not a gate

discovery.selection_rule: Among exactly the frozen m+n=64 budget splits, select the split with minimum mean heldout median local-action residual across both discovery seeds; tie-break by lower worst-seed residual, then lower |m-n|, then lower m.
discovery.winner_is_viable_if: the selected split has heldout median local-action residual <= 0.45 independently on both discovery seeds

replication.formal_hardware: Kaggle GPU for hidden/write extraction; coordinate decomposition is CPU-safe

stop_rule.if_discovery_not_viable: Do not run confirmation. Close 009A as GEOMETRY_DISCOVERY_NO_VIABLE_BUDGET_SPLIT and reconsider the shared-factor hypothesis.
stop_rule.if_confirmation_negative: Do not proceed to routing/certificate/continual-learning variants of factorized coordinates without a new hypothesis.
stop_rule.if_confirmation_positive: Proceed to a separate 009B sparsity/addressability study before any continual-learning mechanism.

interpretation_boundary: A positive 009A establishes only that shared two-sided linear factor spaces preserve heldout local functional action under this budget and data regime.

Frobenius reconstruction is diagnostic rather than a support discriminator; its numeric gate is fixed at the non-discriminative orthogonal-projection bound of 1.0 only as an implementation sanity check.
A positive 009A does not establish that factor coordinates are sparse, identifiable from inference-visible context, safe to mutate continually, or sufficient for an end-to-end language model.
A negative 009A is evidence against the current shared linear left/right coordinate hypothesis; it is not evidence against continual learning in general.
Core 008 and its postmortem remain immutable historical evidence and are not overwritten by 009A.
